jython:import re
   import collections

   # Convert all characters to lowercase and remove non-alphabetic characters
   value = re.sub(r'\W+', '', value.lower())

   # Group the cleaned values by their first letter (assuming that the first letter of a facility name is unique)
   grouped_values = collections.defaultdict(list)
   for val in value:
       grouped_values[val[0]].append(val)

   # Find the most common value in each group and return it as the transformed value
   result = {}
   for key, values in grouped_values.items():
       unique_values = set(values)
       most_common_value = max(unique_values, key=unique_values.count)
       result[key] = most_common_value

   return result
return value
